name: Death's Watch Waystation
summary: Death's Watch Waystation is a small military outpost positioned southeast of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Staffed by the Forsaken Deathguard, the camp secures the local roadways against Scourge stragglers, beasts, and hostile Scarlet intruders.

sections.title: A Bulwark on the Road
sections.body: Situated just down the road from the town of Brill, Death's Watch Waystation serves as an essential picket post for the Forsaken military. The surrounding glades remain fraught with peril, from feral wildlife warped by plague to prowling remnants of the mindless Scourge. By maintaining a fortified presence at this junction, the Deathguard monitors traffic moving through central Tirisfal, ensuring travelers and couriers can traverse the roads between local strongholds without falling prey to ambushes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Death's Watch Waystation?
aliases: why is deaths watch waystation here
faq.answer: It serves as a fortified forward post for the Deathguard, protecting the roads southeast of Brill from hostile creatures, Scourge holdouts, and infiltrating enemies.
The post is operated by the Deathguard, the standing military and policing force of the Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades.

aliases: how to find deaths watch waystation
faq.answer: It lies directly southeast of Brill along the dirt thoroughfare that runs through central Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: Waystations like this are vital lifelines across Tirisfal, demonstrating the Deathguard's tireless vigilance in carving out a secure homeland from the ruins of Lordaeron.
For travelers from Kalimdor navigating the gloomy woods of Tirisfal, Deathguard encampments like Death's Watch provide reassurance and clear signposts in an unfamiliar land.
